context: Tests embeds, tags, aliases, the verify step and the boundary for non-vault Markdown.

checklist.name: Nested tag with slash
checklist.description: The tag `research/papers` uses a forward slash for hierarchy.

checklist.name: Tags have no spaces
checklist.description: No tag contains a space; 'to-read' uses a hyphen.

checklist.name: Tag with digits does not start with a digit
checklist.description: The tag `q4_2026` keeps digits after the first character and underscores are allowed.

checklist.name: Alias in frontmatter
checklist.description: The frontmatter has `aliases:` containing `Papers to Read`.

checklist.name: Frontmatter is first in the file
checklist.description: The YAML frontmatter block starts on line 1 of `reading-list.md`.

checklist.name: README uses standard Markdown links
checklist.description: `README.md` links to the reading list with `[text](reading-list.md)` rather than `[[wikilinks]]`, because it renders on GitHub outside Obsidian.

checklist.name: External URL is a Markdown link
checklist.description: `https://example.org/docs` appears as `[text](url)` and is not wrapped in `[[...]]`.

checklist.name: States how the result was checked
checklist.description: The reply says the note should be checked in Obsidian's reading view, and that the README is plain Markdown for GitHub.
